title: RelationshipEdge
description: A typed, bitemporal relationship edge between two entities (the relationship table row of M-6), distinct from the six canonical record relations of C-23. A memory record of type MemoryRecord with subject, predicate and object; valid_from/valid_to say when it held in the world, recorded_at/superseded_at when One learned or invalidated it. A change closes the old edge (new version with valid_to) and opens a new one; both stay queryable. M-6, M-10, M-11, C-12.
